clips.title: The story
paras: Dark Cleric Beryl is a Forsaken priest trainer stationed in the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. He guides newly awakened undead priests as they learn to wield shadow magic and adapt to their new, unholy existence under the Dark Lady.

Residing on the upper floor of the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, Dark Cleric Beryl serves the Forsaken by mentoring nascent priests. Beryl teaches that a Forsaken priest's power comes from darkness and shadow, yet one must also know the light before mastering the dark. He assists newly risen practitioners as they turn their focus toward shadow and the dark arts, guiding them through early trials like crafting their Garments of Darkness and proving their dedication to the new path.
